Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one simple pixel-art icon for a game level. Catalog 11–13 is metadata only, never draw any words or numbers.
Draw one CLASSIC HOT-AIR BALLOON centered on pure WHITE #FFFFFF, with one shallow BLUE cloud band stretching across the entire bottom edge. This is NOT a cartoon character: absolutely NO FACE, eyes, mouth, people, animals, plant, stars, hearts or other decorations.

Geometry / style: coarse pixel art, as simple as a real 24 columns by 21 rows logical pixel grid, slightly wider than tall (24:21 aspect ratio). All blocks are the SAME square pixel size and align to the SAME grid. Straight square cells and stair-step curves. A magnified pixel icon, not a smooth illustration. No outlines, no stroke, no visible grid lines. Every region a completely flat solid fill, no gradients, shading, texture, dithering, glow or antialiasing.

Composition: A single large balloon occupies about THREE QUARTERS of the image height including basket, with clear white margin around it. Envelope rounded and broad at the top, tapering down to a narrow neck, an inverted teardrop silhouette, distinctly a hot-air balloon rather than a round ball. Suggested coarse layout: envelope approximately rows 2–13, green neck at row 14, orange ropes at rows 15–16, small orange square basket at rows 17–18, shallow bottom blue cloud at rows 19–20 (0-based 21 rows). Do not draw these guides or numerals.
The envelope has exactly FIVE VERY BROAD alternating VERTICAL curved gores, arranged LEFT TO RIGHT: PURPLE, BLUE, PURPLE, BLUE, PURPLE. The bands fan in curved arcs outward from a common top center, follow the bulging volume of the envelope, and converge toward its neck. Express those arcs as simple chunky stair steps in the square grid. Purple-blue stripe boundaries have no outlines.
A GREEN horizontal collar around the narrow lower neck. TWO clearly visible ORANGE suspension ropes connect this collar/envelope to a SMALL ORANGE SQUARE BASKET. The basket is a solid square block, not a boat or a flowerpot. No gaps in the ropes' attachment.
At the very bottom, a single shallow, wide BLUE CLOUD shape with a few large stepped lobes runs across the ENTIRE canvas width and touches the bottom edge without any white margin below it.

Use ONLY these exact FOUR foreground colors plus pure white background:
PURPLE #BD80FF
BLUE #42A9FF
ORANGE #FF9D30
GREEN #62E18E
WHITE #FFFFFF only as background / gaps between separate shapes.
NO black, outlines, extra colors, shadows, highlights, gradient, texture, text, border, watermarks or UI.
One full image, not a collage or sprite sheet.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one simple pixel-art icon for a game level. Catalog 14–16 is metadata only, never draw any words or numbers.
Draw TWO CLASSIC HOT-AIR BALLOONS floating in a pure WHITE #FFFFFF sky, one LARGE balloon on the LEFT and one SMALL balloon on the RIGHT at a slightly higher position. A single shallow BLUE CLOUD band spans the full bottom edge. No face, eyes, mouth, people, animals, plants, stars, hearts or extra decorations.

Geometry / style: extremely simple coarse pixel art, like a real 24-column by 21-row pixel canvas enlarged with nearest-neighbor. Aspect ratio 24:21, slightly wider than tall. ALL blocks are equally sized square pixels aligned to ONE common grid, including both balloons, ropes, baskets and cloud. Use large flat connected color shapes and stair-step curves. No stroke or outlines. No visible grid lines, gradients, texture, shading, antialiasing, shadows or highlights.

Composition:
LEFT LARGE BALLOON: approx three quarters of the image height including basket. Its envelope is broad and rounded at the top, narrows at the bottom into a neck, an inverted teardrop silhouette. Broad alternating PURPLE and BLUE VERTICAL stripes; five broad gores if readable at this coarse resolution (purple-blue-purple-blue-purple). The gores arc outward from the balloon's top center to follow the rounded envelope, and converge again at its narrow neck. Curves expressed as chunky pixel stair steps, not smooth vector curves. At the neck a GREEN collar. Exactly TWO ORANGE suspension ropes visibly connect to an ORANGE SQUARE BASKET below. Basket is a small solid square block, not a boat. Keep the full balloon within the frame.
RIGHT SMALL BALLOON: about HALF the large balloon's height AND width, clearly smaller, separated from the large balloon by visible white sky, and positioned somewhat higher. The small envelope has simple broad alternating GREEN and PURPLE vertical stripes following the same rounded-top tapered-bottom shape. A tiny ORANGE square basket below, visibly attached with minimal orange suspension blocks. The small balloon must remain readable at the same coarse pixel size; it uses fewer square pixels, not smaller or finer pixels. Keep it within the frame.
BOTTOM: one shallow, wide BLUE cloud mass, a few large stepped lobes, horizontally spans the ENTIRE canvas width and touches the exact bottom edge, no white margin beneath. No other clouds or background motifs.

Palette: ONLY #BD80FF purple, #42A9FF blue, #FF9D30 orange, #62E18E green, and #FFFFFF white background. All flat solid color blocks. No black, no additional colors, no text, numbers, title, legend, border, watermark or UI. One complete scene containing exactly two hot-air balloons.
